newsitem.title: CANADA: Markborough shares up in wake of article.
newsitem.headline: Markborough shares up in wake of article.

text.p: Markborough Properties Inc was among the most active stocks on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Monday following a favorable mention of the company in a weekend newspaper article.
Shares in the Toronto-based real estate company jumped C$0.12 to C$0.59 on volume of more than 700,000 shares in early afternoon trade.

A Financial Post article on the prospects for the real estate industry for 1997 said analysts view Markborough as "the company to watch this year." The article also said there is speculation the company could be a takeover target.
A company official said Markborough has not made any recent move or announcement which would prompt a sharp jump in its share price

"We have not announced anything. The most recent thing we announced was our third quarter results which were nothing out of the ordinary," said Simon Nyilassy, chief financial officer for Markborough. "That (article) is the only thing that we are aware of that's in the public domain that might have caused it."
Nyilassy noted that because Markborough is a so-called "penny stock" worth less than a dollar it is not that unusual for the company to trade a high number of shares.
